notes: Payroll statutory structure for companies in the DR Congo (docs/modules/payroll.md, PAY-07, PAY-08, PAY-21). Structure only: no figure is entered until it is confirmed from an official source with its legal reference and effective date. A value that is null is 'rate needed' and blocks payroll runs; a value that is absent does not apply (remove a value, e.g. a ceiling, to say it does not exist). Every money figure is per month in minor units of the pack currency (CDF, no decimals) as a digit string; rates are percentages as strings ('12.5' = 12.5 %). Salaries paid in another currency (e.g. USD) are converted to CDF at the company's rate on the pay date before these figures apply. effective_from 2026-01-01 is the date this pack's data starts, not the date any law took effect. rounding is {mode: half_up|down|up, unit_minor: digits} applied once to the component's result. Labels live in lang/{locale}/payroll.php (pack.*).
todo: ipr: the IPR bands as monthly CDF amounts (each band's upper limit and rate), with the legal reference (Code des impôts) and effective date.
ipr: the maximum IPR as a percentage of taxable pay (max_rate), or remove it if there is none, and the rounding rule of IPR.
ipr_dependants: the IPR reduction per dependant (rate of the tax) and the maximum number of dependants; used only when an employee has dependants.
cnss: the CNSS employee and employer pension rates, whether a ceiling applies to the base (base_cap_minor, or remove it), whether the employee's CNSS reduces taxable pay, and its rounding rule.
cnss_risks: the CNSS employer rate for occupational risks, and its rounding rule.
cnss_family: the CNSS employer rate for family benefits, and its rounding rule.
inpp: the INPP employer rates by headcount bracket (upper headcount of each bracket and its rate), and its rounding rule.
onem: the ONEM employer rate, and its rounding rule.

family_allowance: the statutory family allowance per child per month (allocations familiales), whether it is taxable and subject to contributions, and its rounding rule; used only when an employee has children.
Bases: confirm that CNSS is on contributory gross pay (the earnings the company marks contributory) and that INPP and ONEM are on gross pay.
Other statutory items not modelled yet (e.g. a minimum wage check, housing and transport allowance exemptions, an exceptional tax on expatriates' pay): confirm which apply.
non_monthly: how the monthly figures apply to weekly and bi-weekly pay ('pro_rata' or another method); until then only monthly runs are calculated.
returns: the IPR (DGI), CNSS, INPP and ONEM declaration layouts; until then return files are placeholders.
